description: This file defines the PropertyServiceImpl class, which implements the PropertyService interface to provide configuration properties for batch job partitioning and threading in the Fineract project.

classes.name: PropertyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of PropertyService that retrieves batch job configuration properties from FineractProperties.

methods.name: getPartitionSize
methods.description: Returns the partition size for a given job name from properties.

methods.name: getChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the chunk size for a given job name from properties.

methods.name: getRetryLimit
methods.description: Returns the retry limit for a given job name from properties.

methods.name: getThreadPoolCorePoolSize
methods.description: Returns the core pool size for thread pool for a given job name.

methods.name: getThreadPoolMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pool size for thread pool for a given job name.

methods.name: getThreadPoolQueueCapacity
methods.description: Returns the queue capacity for thread pool for a given job name.

methods.name: getPollInterval
methods.description: Returns the poll interval for a given job name.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Private helper method that fetches specific property values based on job name and property function.
